sentences.en: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
sentences.zh: 在C语言和C++中，声明变量极其重要。

sentences.en: Tomorrow we expect variable weather with a likely chance of precipitation.
sentences.zh: 预计明天天气多变，并有可能出现降水。

sentences.en: Probit statistical models can be used for binary variables.
sentences.zh: Probit统计模型可用于二元变量。
